Casserole, Aetheris, and Roux

    Casserole and Aetheris

    This tree is the formal documentation of the Java sources in Casserole 0.0.1-SNAPSHOT. The tool is javadoc. The sources are the main tree. The comments on those sources are the text.

    Three package groups sit on this page. Casserole is the program that starts. Aetheris is the desktop. Roux is the memory library the program scans with the other two. A type in one group can link to a type in another because this tree was built in one pass.

    Every type and every member is included. A public member and a private member both keep the comment that was written on them.
